name: Card Payment
definition: Payment through an electronic money product.

AmountQualifier.name: Amount Qualifier
AmountQualifier.definition: Identification of the type of amount.

TransactionCategory.name: Transaction Category
TransactionCategory.definition: Specifies the category to which the card transaction belongs.

CashBackAmount.name: Cash Back Amount
CashBackAmount.definition: Amount added to the total price of the transaction and received in cash by the customer.

Gratuity.name: Gratuity
Gratuity.definition: Amount tendered for a service performed.

DebitCreditDirection.name: Debit Credit Direction
DebitCreditDirection.definition: Specifies the direction of a payment.

PaymentCard.name: Payment Card
PaymentCard.definition: Specifies the card which is used in a payment by card.

CardPaymentAcquiring.name: Card Payment Acquiring
CardPaymentAcquiring.definition: Parameters of the process of acquiring a card payment.

PaymentCardPartyRole.name: Payment Card Party Role
PaymentCardPartyRole.definition: Specifies each role played by a party in the process of a payment by card.

CardPaymentStatus.name: Card Payment Status
CardPaymentStatus.definition: Status of the payment by card.

Reconciliation.name: Reconciliation
Reconciliation.definition: Total of a certain type of transaction.
